# The spaces API icon test separates theme-role constants from expected-icon keys

The port defines LIGHT_THEME_ICON as dark.png and DARK_THEME_ICON as light.png, then uses different role mappings for input themeIcons and expected icon fields. Its helper selects icons[config.selectedTheme] and compares actual computed image content and the pinned menu's icon property. The custom-light case selects dark; the inspected built-in/default cases select light. These are this test's inputs and expectation keys, not a global filename or engine-color rule. No rendering or DPI test ran.

Scope: Spaces API icon test expectations.
